summary: StayOS V1 regression pass #2 — verified all 8 fixes from iteration_2 plus re-ran the previously green staff workflows. Backend: extended /app/tests/stayos_regression_test.py to 61 pytest cases (added TestIteration3Fixes class: FRONT_DESK housekeeping dashboard/rooms/needs-attention/employees 200s, razorpay order 503-not-500 + config `configured` flag, source-level assertions for the employees credential leak / duplicate Hindi chip / login testids) and made the lifecycle fixture pick the first room type that actually has inventory (Deluxe is now sold out in the seed, which was causing 13 cascading false failures). 61/61 pytest cases pass. Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): FIX#1 Front Desk /housekeeping renders 24 rooms + Requires Attention with ZERO 403s; FIX#2 CheckoutModal shows only 'Record manual payment' with the cash/card/UPI-at-reception help text and no checkout-razorpay button; FIX#3 /settings, /settings/users, /settings/employees, /settings/room-types all redirect FRONT_DESK and HOUSEKEEPING away while Owner still sees Users/Employees/Room Types tiles; FIX#4 no 'bootstrap:demo-employees' / 'Gaurav Gaur' / 'Password123!' text on /settings/employees; FIX#5 Move Room modal titled 'Move Room' with 'Move Room' CTA and Assign Room modal still correct ('Choose a ready room'); FIX#6 /check-in?reservationId=<id> redirects to /reservations/<id>/check-in and /check-in redirects to /reservations, no 404s; FIX#7 only English + Hindi chips on /guests/new; FIX#8 login-email/login-password/login-submit testids present and used by all scripts. SANITY: full UI checkout on HSDEMO-0022 (Check Out -> Record manual payment 201 -> folio FULLY PAID + receipt Download/Email/WhatsApp -> Complete checkout 200 -> stepper shows Checked Out); receipt.pdf returns application/pdf (%PDF magic) via pytest; check-in workspace enforces 4 blockers; housekeeping Assign->Start->Complete->Inspect->Mark Ready all 200 and KPI strip updates (Waiting Inspection 1->0, Ready 6->7); billing folio Add Charge + Collect Payment (6 methods) modals work and Settle Folio is disabled at balance ₹11,760 / enabled at ₹0. 2 NEW defects found (hardcoded localhost:3002 API fallback in the shared app-shell, and 'Complete on behalf' offered on not-started rooms causing a silent 400).

minor.issue: Correctly returns 400 HOUSEKEEPING_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED 'Cannot complete cleaning before start.' — backend is right, but the housekeeping board exposes the 'Complete on behalf' button on not-started (Needs Cleaning) cards, so staff hit this 400 with no visible error. UI-side fix needed.
Still returns 400 for invalid/revoked tokens instead of 401/404 (carried over from iteration_2, low).

ui_bugs.issue: NEW/HIGH: reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL via `globalThis.process?.env`, which Next.js does NOT inline for the browser bundle, so it always falls back to the hardcoded 'http://localhost:3002/api/v1'. Every page fires 2x GET http://localhost:3002/api/v1/properties -> net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (visible as console errors on /housekeeping, /reports, dashboard). The shell's property/room-count strip therefore shows stale data (header says '62 Rooms' while the property has 24). Will be fully broken in production. Fix: reference process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL directly (as packages/ui/src/connectivity/backend-connectivity.tsx already does) and drop the localhost fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: NEW/MEDIUM: cards for assigned-but-not-started rooms render 'Complete on behalf' alongside 'Start Cleaning'. Clicking it PATCHes /complete and gets 400 'Cannot complete cleaning before start.' with no toast/alert shown — silent failure for staff. Either hide the button until status=cleaning or auto-start before completing, and surface the API error.

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: modal opens with 'Checklist 0/7' even though the card says 'Checklist complete · Waiting inspection'; the inspector must re-tick all 7 chips before 'Mark Ready' enables. The housekeeper's submitted checklist is not pre-loaded, which is misleading and doubles the work.

Testability gap: app/housekeeping/page.tsx has ZERO data-testid attributes (cards, Assign Staff / Start Cleaning / Complete on behalf / Inspect Room / Mark Ready buttons, KPI tiles, Staff Access). Automation must rely on role+text and modal-index heuristics, which is brittle (a page-level filter Select and the modal Select both matched [role=option]).

The requested behaviour 'clicking an empty cell opens the New Booking flow prefilled' is NOT implemented — the 336 day cells are plain <Box> with no onClick/href (only reservation bars link to /reservations/:id). Verified in browser: clicking an empty cell does nothing (no navigation, no modal). Cells also have no data-testid.
Every room row shows room type as '—' (roomTypeName missing/unmapped in the availability payload) while the same rooms show 'Deluxe/Suite' elsewhere.
Still the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of Mantine DateInput (known, main agent deferred).

critical_code_review_comments: packages/ui/src/layout/stayos-app-shell.tsx: environment lookup via `globalThis.process?.env` defeats Next.js compile-time inlining of NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars; combined with a hardcoded localhost fallback this silently sends browser traffic to localhost:3002. The same file should follow the pattern already used in packages/ui/src/connectivity/backend-connectivity.tsx.

Housekeeping board: primaryAction/secondary-action visibility is computed client-side and drifts from the server state machine (complete-before-start). Derive the allowed transitions from the API's primaryAction field instead of duplicating the rules.
Housekeeping mutations swallow API errors — the 400 from /complete produced no toast; every mutation should surface error.message.
settings/layout.tsx guard is correct but redirects HOUSEKEEPING to /front-desk; consider a role-appropriate landing (/housekeeping) so housekeepers do not land on a front-desk dashboard.
app/housekeeping/page.tsx is a very large single client component with all modals inline; split into components and add testids.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) localhost:3002 requests: apiBaseUrl() in packages/ui/src/layout/stayos-app-shell.tsx resolves env vars through `globalThis.process?.env`. Next.js replaces only literal `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_*` references at build time, so the indirect lookup is undefined in the browser and the hardcoded 'http://localhost:3002/api/v1' fallback is used -> ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED for GET /properties on every page. 2) Housekeeping 400: the board's card actions render 'Complete on behalf' whenever a room has an assigned employee, ignoring whether cleaning has started; the API state machine (start -> complete) rejects it with 400 and the client swallows the error. 3) The 13 pytest failures seen mid-pass were test-data exhaustion, not product bugs — the lifecycle fixture always asked for roomTypes[0] (Deluxe), which now has zero availability for today->+2; the fixture now iterates room types.
